Kuvitus: leikkikentän karuselli pyörii k: Illustration: a playground roundabout turning on a summer day. One child stands at the edge of the roundabout, another near the centre pole. At each child there is a blue arrow in the direction of motion, along the tangent of the path; the arrow of the child at the edge is twice as long as that of the child near the centre.
Kaavakuva: kappale kiertää ympyrärataa v: Formula figure: an object circles a circular path anticlockwise. A blue velocity vector is drawn at four points: all are equally long and along the tangent of the path, perpendicular to the radius drawn from the centre. On the right it says that the magnitudes of the velocities are equal but the vectors are different.
Kaavakuva: naruun sidottu kiekko kiertää: Formula figure: a puck tied to a string circles a peg anticlockwise along a circular path drawn with a dashed line. At the lowest point of the path the string breaks, and the puck continues straight to the right along the tangent of the path. The positions of the puck are marked at equal time intervals: the gaps are equally long, so the speed stays the same.
Kaavakuva: vasemmalla ympyräradan kaari: Formula figure: on the left an arc of a circular path and two successive positions of an object, where the velocities are equally long but point in different directions. On the right the same vectors have been moved to start from the same point, and the black arrow from the tip of the first to the tip of the second is the change of velocity. The second velocity is the first velocity plus the change of velocity.
Kaavakuva ylhäältä: kaksi kohtaa A ja B: Formula figure from above: two points A and B are on the same radius of a rotating roundabout, A at the distance r and B at the distance 2r from the centre. In the same time each turns through the same fraction of a revolution, but the arc travelled by B is twice as long, and the blue velocity vector of B is twice as long as that of A. The proportions are to scale.
Vaihtoehto: naru katkeaa merkityssä kohd: Option: the string breaks at the marked point, and the puck continues along a straight path that is along the tangent of the path, that is, perpendicular to the direction of the string.
Option: the string breaks at the marked point, and the puck continues along a straight path away from the peg in the direction of the string.
Option: the string breaks at the marked point, and the puck still follows the same circular path for some distance.
Option: the string breaks at the marked point, and the puck continues along a straight path diagonally between the tangent of the path and the direction of the string.
